question: Does retained exact-Camry traffic support 0x081 B13[7:6] as the lateral fail class described by Toyota US20230082947A1, and what does the startup/failure timing reveal?

states: abnormality detected / failure not yet confirmed / control invalid
patent.note: The patent permits a two-bit fail class but does not assign binary values to the four semantic states.

drs_p5.name: DRS Fail Class

display.2: Steering control request is not executable (temporary)
display.3: Steering control request is not executable (with failure decided)

drs_p5.boundary: Independent Toyota steering-family diagnostic vocabulary; not exact-F33 proof.

healthy_corpus.interpretation: Across the declared healthy corpus, high2=2 appears only in four startup episodes; high2=1 and high2=3 never appear.

route45_startup.adjacent_application_payload_difference: B13 only; security trailer changes as expected

surrounding_state.request_0x08a: lateral ID 0 and pinion angle 0 both before and after transition
surrounding_state.id_0x251_first8: 8000000080000080 both before and after in immediate +/-2 s window

request_loss_negative_control.experiment: FRC normal-Tx suppression with EPS/Brake alive
request_loss_negative_control.result: 0x081 B11 changes 0x04 -> 0x14 while B13 remains 0 and B16:B17 remains 59; state recovers when FRC Tx returns.
request_loss_negative_control.interpretation: Brake has a request/source-loss supervisor distinct from the B13 steering-actuator/fail-class path.

interpretation: The experiment validly rules out mere raw 0x030 message presence as sufficient.
It does not isolate SecOC freshness as the only cause: the repeated payload itself kept the recovered B6[0] torque-validity/invalid gate asserted.
A fresh, accepted, semantically healthy EPS status continuity test remains distinct from the stale-presence test.

early030_unproven_support.note: Both have B6[0]=1, so the first application-return publication is still in the torque-invalid/startup-validity state.

strongest_inferences: B13[7:6] is now a very strong candidate lateral fail-class field rather than an arbitrary whole-byte result ID extension.
Observed high2=2 behaves as a temporary/startup non-executable state; observed high2=3 behaves as failure-decided/confirmed in dead-EPS and post-bootstrap faulted states.
The exact 0x80->0xC0 d4 transition changes only B13 inside the 0x081 application payload, while the request plane and known request-loss supervisor stay stable.

The healthy startup resolution of high2=2 follows 0x030 B6[0] clearing by 19.856..40.711 ms in four independent starts. This is a strong temporal join, not proof that B6[0] is the sole reliability input.
The stale-030 negative should no longer be described as favoring freshness alone; payload validity and freshness remain confounded.
next_actions: Add passive bootstrap logging for 0x081 B13[7:6], 0x030 B6[0], 0x030 B6[2]/B16[0]/B19[0], 0x51E READY, and FRC 0x1905/0x1906.
Recover or capture Operation-FFD 0x5283_1 synchronously with raw 0x081 to close the wire mapping directly.
Treat the existing stale-030 replay as a message-presence negative, not a healthy-status-continuity negative.
If testing prevention, distinguish a valid/fresh semantically healthy EPS status path from stale replay; do not promote any synthetic status masking to production behavior.

A bounded parked diagnostic that re-signs only the candidate 0x081 fail-class bits could test whether FRC X2400 consumes this field, but it would be a diagnostic causal test rather than a production fix.
